description_en: Sets the status of a whiteboard application. Valid values: 1 (enabled) and 2 (disabled)
description_zh: 为白板应用设置状态，1:启用，2:停用
name: SetAppStatus

parameters.description_en: The unique identifier of the whiteboard application. To obtain the whiteboard application ID, see [CreateApp](~~204234~~).
parameters.description_zh: 白板应用唯一标识符。获取白板应用ID，请参见[CreateApp](~~204234~~)。
parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the whiteboard application. To obtain the whiteboard application ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204234.html
parameters.help_zh: 白板应用唯一标识符。获取白板应用ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204234.html
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.description_en:
The status of the whiteboard application. Valid values:

- **1**: Enabled.
- **2**: Disabled.

- **2**：停用。
